start: Settings > Gym details, one branch, gym web pages on

steps.action: Read under the gym name box
user_sees: 'This name shows in your members’ MettleUp app and on your receipts.'
must_not: No line
Two sentences or a line that ends without a full stop

steps.action: Read under Phone, GSTIN and Address
user_sees: 'This number is printed on your receipts, and your web page can show it with a Call button.'
'If your gym is registered for GST, this number shows on your receipts.'
'This address shows on your receipts and on your web page.'
must_not: A line that says something the receipt does not do

steps.action: Read under the UPI ID box
user_sees: 'Fee reminders, renewal messages and receipts show this UPI ID with a link that opens the member’s UPI app with the amount already filled in.'
must_not: The UPI line shown where no UPI box is

start: The other settings screens (other kinds: tick boxes and boxes on Payments, Branding, Branches, Member app, Gym timings, Web page, Entry machines)

user_sees: 'Tick this box to show members a Pay now button in the MettleUp app for what they owe, or leave it unticked so that they pay at the desk.'
'Tick this box to let people who join with your join link pay for their plan online, or leave it unticked so that they pay at the desk.'
must_not: The line and the tick box saying opposite things

steps.action: Open Member app (Plus lock, Busy machines, Bring a friend)
user_sees: 'Tick this box to stop the paid features <n> days after a member’s plan ends until they renew, while their workouts are always kept.' with the real number of days
'Tick this box to show members one tip on the Gym tab of their app, for example “Leg day is quieter on Tuesday”.'
'Type how many free days a member gets, with one tap from you, for each friend who joins through their invite link, or leave it empty to give none.'
must_not: '{n}' shown as it is, not as a number

user_sees: 'Tick this box to let anyone with the link see your web page, and untick it at any time to hide the page.'
'Tick this box so that Google may show your web page in search results, or leave it unticked so that only people with the link find it.'
must_not: A line under a box that is greyed with no reason

steps.action: Open Entry machines and Gym timings
user_sees: 'You find this number on the machine under Menu > System Info > Serial Number.'
'Type up to 120 letters here to tell members something they should know about your gym timings.'
must_not: A letter limit in the line that differs from what the box takes

start: Settings > Gym details in the two cases where the usual line would be untrue

steps.action: Open it while gym web pages are switched off
user_sees: Under Phone: 'This number is printed on your receipts.'
Under Address: 'This address shows on your receipts.'
must_not: A line that talks about a web page the gym cannot have

steps.action: Open it in a gym with more than one branch
user_sees: 'Members of this branch see this name in their MettleUp app and on its receipts.'
'If this branch is registered for GST, this number shows on its receipts.'
must_not: The one-branch wording in a branch

start: Settings > Member app, the Plus lock tick box

steps.action: Tick the box, save, untick it, save
user_sees: The same sentence under the box both times
must_not: The line vanishing when the box is off

steps.action: Switch the panel to Hinglish and open the same screen
user_sees: The Hinglish sentence under the box
must_not: English under one box and Hinglish under the next

start: Settings, the lines that make a promise

user_sees: '… while their workouts are always kept.'
must_not: A member’s workouts removed or hidden when the paid features lock

user_sees: '… untick it at any time to hide the page.'
'… so that only people with the link find it.'
must_not: The page still open after the box is unticked
The page offered to Google while the box is off

user_sees: '… with one tap from you …'
must_not: Free days given without the owner’s tap

start: A settings screen the front desk may open (which ones: not checked)

user_sees: The same one sentence under each setting as the owner sees
must_not: A different wording for the front desk
A line under a setting the front desk cannot change, with no word that it is the owner’s

steps.action: Try to open an owner-only settings screen (Payments, Branding, Staff & sign-in)
user_sees: The usual refusal or the screen without its owner-only parts
must_not: The setting and its line shown as if the front desk could change it

start: A settings screen the front desk may open, panel language changed by the owner to Hinglish

user_sees: The Hinglish sentence under each setting
must_not: The English line left behind for the front desk
